18 March 2024: A medical facility was raided by Israeli forces for the fourth time since 07 October 2023 on the belief that the medical facility is connected to a tunnel network used as a base for Hamas and other Palestinian fighters. The surgery building with medical staff, patients and displaced individuals trapped inside was hit with explosives and Israeli army vehicles and tanks were stationed inside the medical facility’s courtyard. Those seen moving inside the building were shot at. People inside the medical facility and surrounding areas were ordered to evacuate. Israeli soldiers claimed an exchange of fire with Hamas fighters inside the medical facility. As of 25th March, IDF claimed that 170 armed Palestinians killed and some 500 suspects were detained. An image published on 15th May showed that some of the detained were doctors and two head of departments. The IDF withdrew in the early hours of April 1st. The buildings of the medical facility were extensively damaged and the medical facility is no longer operable. All medical equipment was destroyed. On 01 September, the emergency department was officially reopened. A physician who had been detained during the raid died in an Israeli prison on 18th September.

15 February 2024: A medical facility, including the maternity department, was raided and turned into a military base by Israeli forces on allegations that Hamas militants were hiding inside and holding Israeli hostages. At least 70 health workers were arrested and 95 health workers, as well as their family members, patients, and patient companions, were moved to another building in the compound without food and water. The southern wall of the medical facility was demolished and two ambulances destroyed. The next day, Israeli forces again moved male patients and their companions to the maternity building. Between 18-20 February, WHO evacuated around 43 patients in critical condition with the support of Red Cross and UN. As of 20 February, the ICU was no longer functioning and the remaining ICU patient was transferred to a different part of the complex. 110 patients and around 15 doctors and nurses remained at the medical facility. On 22 February, IDF withdrew from the medical facility, although the siege continued, severely restricting movement to and from the complex. On 27 February, 120 patients required medical evacuation from the now non-functional medical facility. On 12 March, two doctors who had been released reported that they had been tortured. On 5th and 8th April, two more doctors were released. On 22 September, it was reported that there was no trace of the gastroenterology specialist who had been detained in any IDF prison, detention centre or camp, and he was recorded as killed.

January 2023: In Al Hol Camp, nine people were detained during a security operation in the fifth section of camp by SDF.
January 2023: Women were sexually abused by unidentified Mai-Mai during a raid on camp. Money and good were taken and a man was threatened.

January 2023: A male refugee was stabbed to death during fighting between rival gangs in Kiryandongo Refugee Camp.
January 2023: A Rohingya community leader was shot and killed by ARSA members in Balukhali Refugee Camp.
January 2023: A Rohingya community leader was stabbed and killed by unidentified perpetrators in the Ukhiya Refugee Camp.

January 2023: Four IDPs were injured and IDP housing was damaged when Syrian regime army rockets were fired at an IDP camp.
January 2023: In Al Hol Camp, eight people were detained on charges of links to IS during a security operation in the camp by Asayish forces.
January 2023: In Al Hol Camp, three people were detained during a security operation in the camp by SDF.

January 2023: In Roj Camp, a woman from Uzbekistan was detained during a security operation in the camp by SDF.

December 2022: Five people were injured when a grenade was thrown into a refugee camp.

December 2022: One person was injured by an armed group attack in the Nyamusasi IDP Camp.
December 2022: Two IDP's were killed in a reported gunfight with police at and 78 Rohingya individuals, including a leader of the Arakan Rohingya Salvation Army (ARSA).
December 2022: Three Iraqi individuals were detained during a security operation in a camp by Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on charges of belonging to IS.
Decmeber 2022: Three IDP's were kidnapped from a refugee camp by gunmen.
December 2022: Homes were burned and shots were fired during a raid of a refugee camp.
December 2022: A currency exchange shop owner in a refugee camp was shot and killed by unidentified armed woman.

A Palestinian male, aged 22, was fatally shot.
December 2022: A refugee camp was looted overnight by armed men.

December 2022: In Jenin Refugee Camp, Israeli soldiers raided the camp where they were met by gunfire. As the soldiers engaged in an exchange of fire, two Palestinian men were killed, one was a prominent Palestinian Islamic Jihad member, and the other was allegedly involved in shooting attacks on Israeli troops.
November 2022: In Cox’s Bazar district, Chittagong division, a Rohingya leader and volunteer was stabbed to death inside his home at a refugee camp by unidentified perpetrators.

November 2022: In Fashoda county, Upper Nile state, an IDP camp was attacked by an armed militia. An unconfirmed report says at least 3,000 IDPs were killed. The entire camp population has been re-displaced.

November 2022: In al-Hasakah governorate, five Turkish airstrikes targeted Kurdish security forces responsible for protecting an IDP camp, prompting a number of Islamic State-linked families to take advantage of the situation and escape.
November 2022: In Mayo-Sava department, Extreme-Nord region, an IDP camp was looted by suspected ISWAP or Boko Haram fighters who stole crops and two bicycles.

November 2022: In an unnamed IDP camp, 11 people were killed and one injured by Islamist militants who attacked on the camp and set fire to shelters and food reserves, before taking away all livestock.
November 2022: In Erbil governorate, a refugee camp was reportedly targeted by drone strikes.

November 2022: In a temporary IDP camp, unidentified perpetrators launched three separate attacks on the camp hosting IDPs awaiting assisted return to their home area. At least seven people were killed.
November 2022: In Aleppo governorate, Syrian Democratic Forces militia abducted a girl at an IDP camp and reportedly took her to a recruitment centre.
November 2022: A woman was raped by five men. The case was reported to the police and investigations are ongoing.
November 2022: In Youba IDP Camp, a primary school canteen was looted by an armed group.
November 2022: In Kent country, 16 unaccompanied minor asylum seekers have been attacked by adults at the a Migrant Processing Centre, prompting an intervention by police.
Weapon Carried/Used: No Information on the Weapon Used

Event Description: 09 November 2022: In Refugee Balata Camp, Israeli soldiers raided the camp as part of a wider operation to secure the entry of Israeli politicians to the site of Josephs Tomb. As Palestinian fighters clashed with Israeli troops outside the camp, a sniper shot with live bullets a 15-year-old Palestinian who died shortly after at hospital. The Health Ministry stated that the teen was killed by shrapnel from a handmade explosive device he held during the confrontations. Others were injured by rubber bullets and teargas launched by Israeli soldiers.

November 2022: In Marib governorate, shrapnel from six missiles/rockets fired by forces on an IRG weapons warehouse fell on an IDP camp. Four IDPs, including two children were killed and 23 others were injured, 13 IDP tents were damaged, three were burnt, and 53 water tanks were destroyed.

November 2022: In Maarrat Misrin subdistrict, Idlib district, Russian warplanes and Syrian artillery, dropped banned cluster munitions near four IDP camps located in close proximity to each other. At least nine civilians were killed and at least 75 others got injured. At least 400 families have been displaced anew as a result of such hostilities. Volunteers subsequently found and cleared 14 unexploded submunitions.

November 2022: In Ariha district, Russian warplanes and Syrian artillery, dropped banned cluster munitions near four IDP camps located in close proximity to each other. At least nine civilians were killed and at least 75 others got injured. At least 400 families have been displaced anew as a result of such hostilities. Volunteers subsequently found and cleared 14 unexploded submunitions.

November 2022: In Idlib governorate, Russian warplanes and Syrian artillery, dropped banned cluster munitions near four IDP camps located in close proximity to each other. At least nine civilians were killed and at least 75 others got injured. At least 400 families have been displaced anew as a result of such hostilities. Volunteers subsequently found and cleared 14 unexploded submunitions.
November 2022: In North Kivu province, policemen shot and killed three IDPs while around 15 others were injured after fighting broke out among camp residents.
03 November 2022: In Jenin Refugee Camp, a teenage boy was shot and killed in a military raid on the camp by Israeli forces.

November 2022: In Diffa region, Boko Haram militants invaded an IDP camp, where they started shooting sporadically, killing at least four people and wounding several others. A number of houses were burned down, and shops looted.
November 2022: In Daraa governorate, a boy was indiscriminately shot and killed in crossfire inside a Palestinian refugee camp.

30 October 2022: In Al-Aroub Refugee Camp, Israeli soldiers stationed in a military tower fired metal bullets and teargas canisters at civilians and their homes, leading to clashes at the entrance of the site.
October 2022: In Cox’s Bazar district, Chittagong division, police launched a crackdown inside Refugee Camps, where they captured dozens of suspects linked to a wave of killings targeting refugees.
October 2022: In Jabal al-Ahlam area, Aleppo governorate, shelling resulted in the death of an IDP as well as the injury of two others.

October 2022: In Nicosia district, Congolese and Nigerian residents of an Emergency Reception Centre started throwing rocks and objects at each other after a dispute. Several tents caught fire and some 20 residents as well as security guards were injured. The camp was evacuated by riot police and three people were taken to hospital for treatment.
Victim of Violence: Aid Agency Security Guard , Camp Resident

Event Description: October 2022: In  Cox’s Bazar district, Chittagong division, unidentified perpetrators stabbed and shot to death two refugees.
October 2022: In Cox’s Bazar district, Chittagong division, some 20 unidentified perpetrators shot dead a male refugee.
October 2022: In Farchana Refugee Camp, three Sudanese refugees were injured during an attack by 20 armed herders.
October 2022: In Cox’s Bazar district, Chittagong division, unidentified perpetrators cut the throat of a Rohingya youth and shot him dead.
October 2022: In Cox’s Bazar district, Chittagong division, unidentified perpetrators armed with swords attacked and killed two camp leaders.
October 2022: Near Afrin city, Aleppo governorate, armed clashes sparked a fire within an IDP camp, resulting in the destruction of five tents and the damaging of 25 others.
13 October 2022: In Al-Bureij Refugee Camp, Israeli military forces fired teargas canisters towards a middle school, causing dozens of students to suffer from tear gas inhalation.
October 2022: In Jabal al-Ahlam area, Aleppo governorate, artillery shelling resulted in the death of at least one IDP and the injury of 14 others.
October 2022: In Beqaa valley, security forces stormed refugee camps hosting Syrians, seizing televisions, radios, satellite dishes, mobile phones, and routers.
October 2022: In Afrin district, Aleppo governorate, shrapnel killed one female IDP during clashes. Hundreds of IDPs were forced to flee.
October 2022: In Afrin district, Aleppo governorate, reported clashes between armed groups and the Syrian army injured five civilians and led to panic within the IDP camps.
October 2022: In Cox’s Bazar district, Chittagong division, unidentified perpetrators shot and injured a camp leader.

08 October 2022: In Shuafat Refugee Camp, a 21-year-old Palestinian man reportedly opened fire at a checkpoint, killing an 18-year-old Israeli sergeant. Two other Israeli security personnel were injured. Upon suspicion that the perpetrator went into hiding inside the camp, the Israeli military shut down the camps entry and exit points, bringing life to a standstill for an estimated 60,000 residents. Inside the camp, young men threw Molotov cocktails and rocks at Israeli soldiers, who responded with teargas and rubber bullets. Several children were harmed during the unrest. Eventually, the Israeli military eased the blockade on 13 October.
Victim of Violence: Aid Agency Security Guard , Camp Resident

Event Description: 08 October 2022: In Jenin Refugee Camp, Israeli soldiers raided the camp, where they shot dead two Palestinians, aged 16 and 18, and wounded a 12-year-old boy, who eventually succumbed to his injuries on 10 October.

October 2022: A school housing IDPs was hit by a military airstrike, killing more than 50 displaced people, and injuring at least 70 more. The school was included in a list of sites housing IDPs that the UN sent to the Ethiopian Government last January.
October 2022: In Cox’s Bazar district, Chittagong division, unidentified perpetrators opened fire at the market area of the camp, killing a girl and wounding a woman.
Victim of Violence: Camp Resident, Camp Resident, Camp Resident Child

Event Description: October 2022: In an unnamed refugee camp, South Sudanese refugees was attacked by suspected armed tribesmen, killing 19 people. Four suspects were reportedly arrested.
03 October 2022: Near Jalazone Refugee Camp, Israeli soldiers opened fire on a vehicle near the camp, killing two Palestinian men and injuring another during a raid on the camp.

28 September 2022: In Jenin Refugee Camp, a UNRWA health centre that serves 35,000 people was damaged and services affected following a raid on the camp by Israeli forces who fired shots and teargas. Armed confrontations with residents ensued, and a house was struck by an anti-tank projectile. Two health workers were reportedly injured, four Palestinians were killed, and 40 more injured.

September 2022: Russian airstrikes targeted an El Azza opposition group military base located next to several IDP camps, including Kafr Lusin and al Amal camps, causing widespread distress among IDP residents.

September 2022: Shrapnel from four Russian air raids ripped through tents at a cluster of unnamed IDP camps, injuring women and children. Residents were forced to flee and take shelter under trees or behind rocks

September 2022: A vessel designed for 30 passengers carrying 100-150 migrants sank en route to Cyprus, causing at least 73 to drown. 20 passengers were rescued and medical facilityised, while 31 bodies were found during a search-and-rescue operation. In September, Syrian authorities detained the survivors at a medical facility.
September 2022: In an unnamed refugee camp, three refugees were killed and seven injured in an attack by gunmen. The camp was also looted,

September 2022: In Naivasha Refugee Camp, Khartoum state, a police operation targeting underground alcohol manufacturing around Naivasha Refugee Camp led to homes being burned down in the camp, leaving over 25 households without shelter.

September 2022: At al-Hol Camp, al Hasakah district and governorate, SDF and members of the US-led Coalition rescued two Yazidi girls who had been taken from Iraq several years ago and enslaved and sexually and physically abused by IS sleeper cells at the camp. Additionally, during the raid, an unspecified number of ISIS extremists were detained and an unknown number of weapons were confiscated.
September 2022: At least one youth was killed and four others injured by shells fired by Myanmar forces at a Rohingya refugee camp
September 2022: In Arbat camp, Kurdistan region, children from the camp have reportedly been recruited by members of the Kurdistan Workers’ Party.
September 2022: In Borno state, an IDP camp was attacked by Boko Haram fighters.

07 September 2022. IDP camp on Adhidyang Island, Upper Nile. Forces reportedly allied to the Sudan People’s Liberation Army (SPLA) in Opposition and the White Army, estimated 200-300 elements on canoes, attacked the IDP camp. Many IDPs fled and some got wounded and drowned in the Nile River on their way to Malakal. About ten INGO staff were on the ground when the attack started but managed to flee to Malakal.
Reported Perpetrator Name: SPLA-IO Sudan People's Liberation Army in Opposition

Event Description: September 2022: In Upper Nile state, armed youth known as the White Army, attacked an IDP camp hosting 5-8,000 people, resulting in many deaths, and several other missing. An unknown number of people drowned in the Nile River while fleeing the attack. This attack triggered intercommunal violence among IDPs within the UNMISS Protection Of Civilians site.

September 2022: In eastern Sudan, forced military recruitment has reportedly taken place at refugee camps hosting Ethiopian refugees, days after the resumption of fighting between the TPLF and Ethiopian Government forces in Ethiopia.

September 2022: In Al Faraa Camp, West Bank, Israeli forces raided the camp and killed a young Palestinian man by shooting him in the neck and chest. Palestinians had thrown an IED and fired at soldiers.

September 2022: At al Hol Camp, al Hasakah district and governorate, Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) and members of the US-led coalition rescued four women who were chained and tortured by IS sleeper cells in tunnels at the camp. It is unclear how long the women were kept captive.
September 2022: In North Kivu, police officers clashed with unidentified armed men inside an unnamed IDP camp.

September 2022: In an unnamed IDP camp, successive armed assaults by Cooperative for Development of the Congo (CODECO) men the camp and a health centre were thwarted by the joint intervention of Mission de l'Organisation des Nations Unies pour la stabilisation en République démocratique du Congo (MONUSCO) and the Congolese army.

September 2022: Sudanese authorities urged humanitarian actors to evacuate a border reception centre for Ethiopians fleeing the Tigray war following intensified clashes involving the Ethiopian National Defence Forces, Eritrean forces and the Tigray People’s Liberation Front.

September 2022: In Unity state, heavily armed security forces entered Bentiu IDP camp in two Toyota Landcruiser pickups and detained five male IDPs, taking them to an undisclosed location allegedly for supporting attempts to remove the state’s governor. The victims were reportedly tortured during their captivity before being released the next day following the intervention of the United Nations Mission in South Sudan (UNMISS). One victim was taken to hospital due to his critical condition
August 2022: In Woleh IDP camp, Amhara region, 25 IDPs were reportedly shot and killed inside the camp by the TPLF.
August 2022: A refugee camp was hit by a Turkish drone, killing a man,
August 2022: A refugee camp was equipped with security forces to target ongoing violence by Islamic State.

August 2022: An Bukhali refugee camp, Chittagong division, a Rohingya educator received death and kidnapping threats from members of the Arakan Rohingya Salvation Army and criminal gangs for advocating for the repatriation of refugees.
August 2022: An ambulance, makeshift clinic, and IDP camp were torched as part of a wider attack by Myanmar military.
August 2022: Two Rohingyan community leaders were shot by unidentified perpetrators inside a camp.
August 2022: Three refugees were found murdered inside a refugee camp, suspected to be victims of  Islamic State sleeper cells.

August 2022: In Ukugu Refugee Camp, Gambella region, the camp was reportedly attacked by Murle ethnic militias who had crossed the border from South Sudan, killing two people and injuring another one. Two other civilians were kidnapped.
August 2022: A Palestinian security official was killed by unidentified perpetrators inside a refugee camp.
August 2022: A refugee was killed during active fighting between two groups within a camp.
07 August 2022: In Jabalia Refugee Camp, a stray projectile hit a home, killing two Palestinian men.

August 2022: In Rafah TRefugee Camp, Israeli forces airstrikes hit a three-storey apartment building, killing a senior Islamic Jihad commander, two other militants, and five Palestinian people. A woman and her son suffered shrapnel injuries.
06 August 2022: In Jabalia Refugee Camp, rocket fire landed on the camp, killing six Palestinian people.

02 August 2022. AL-Hol camp, Al -Hasakah governorate. The Syrian Democratic Forces (Al-Asayish) announced foiling an attempt to smuggle 56 individuals of ISIL families (39 children and 17 women), using a truck out of the said camp.
Weapon Carried/Used: No Information on the Weapon Used

Event Description: August 2022: A man was shot dead at a refugee camp during a gunfight between two rival groups.
July 2022: At a refugee camp, Ouaddai region, an armed group opened fire and killed a Sudanese refugee.
July 2022: At a refugee camp, in Ouaddai region, an armed group opened fire and killed a Sudanese women refugee. Her daughter was also injured.

July 2022: At a refugee camp in Bamako city, police arrested about 30 people during a raid on the camp which hosts IDPs. The raid occurred following a series of complex attacks across the central and southern regions.
July 2022: In Akkar governorate, several clan members burned down a Syrian refugee camp over suspicions that a resident of the camp was responsible for murdering one of their family members.
July 2022: In Aleppo governorate, Syrian Democratic Forces ground artillery reportedly fired a number of missiles into the camp, resulting in up to three IDP dead and five injured.
July 2022: In Cox's Bazar, militants shot and injured three IDPs.
July 2022: A male traditional medicine practitioner was arrested by Myanmar military.
July 2022: In Duhok governorate, Turkish warplanes conducted airstrikes hitting refugee camp.
July 2022. Peaceful demonstration at an IDP camp.
July 2022: In Sagaing region, the Myanmar military carried out airstrikes against IDP tents.
July 2022: In Hasaka governorate, the body of an IDP was found in an IDP camp bearing gunshot wounds.
16 July 2022. Al-Hol camp, southeast of rural Al-Hasakah governorate. An unidentified body of a woman was found dead, inside a sewage pit in section 5 of the camp. No further details were provided.
Weapon Carried/Used: No Information on the Weapon Used

Event Description: July 2022: In Hasaka governorate, the body of an IDP was found at an IDP camp bearing gunshot wounds.
July 2022: In North Darfur state, IDPs call on regional authorities to deploy protective forces during the upcoming agricultural season in order to protect them whilst cultivating their lands.

July 2022: In North Darfur state, a group of gunmen attacked young IDPs. One of the victims was shot in the arm, and another was stabbed in the face and shoulder. They were both treated in hospital. The attack was caused by friction between two tribal groups.
July 2022: The body of an aid worker was found in Al-Hol camp.
Weapon Carried/Used: No Information on the Weapon Used

Event Description: July 2022: The beheaded body of a young man was found in section 5 of AL-Hol Camp.
July 2022: An Iraqi man was killed by an unidentified perpetrator/s in AL-Hol Camp.
July 2022: In West Darfur state, joint security forces detained four IDP community leaders from an IDP Camp, and transferred them to another city.
July 2022: In the Northern region, a South Sudanese refugee was murdered near a local trading centre at a Refugee Settlement.
July 2022: A refugee camp was hit by a suspected Turkish drone that targeted a house, causing material damage.
June 2022: In North Darfur state, an item of unexploded ordnance (UXO) detonated in an IDP Camp, injuring six children, after one of them found it in a field and brought it home.

29 June 2022. Timbuktu city. Three unidentified armed individuals attempted to hijack an IO vehicle in the Hamabangou neighbourhood. The assailants opened fire at the vehicle, but the driver was able to escape unharmed and return safely to the office.
June 2022: An LNGO educator was attacked and injured with a sharp weapon at a camp.
June 2022: In Juba, clashes involving members of the Murle and Anyak communities erupted at the Mahad IDP Camp, leaving one man dead and several others injured. Police arrested four suspects.
Weapon Carried/Used: No Information on the Weapon Used

Event Description: June 2022: In Al-Hol Camp, Al-Hasakah governorate. The beheaded body of a Syrian woman in section 6 of the camp was found by the Internal Security Forces (ISF/Asayish). The motives and perpetrator's identity are still undisclosed.

June 2022: In Al-Hol Camp, Al-Hasakah governorate. The ISF found a wounded Syrian woman with a gunshot in the head in section 6 of the camp. The motives and perpetrator's identity are still undisclosed.

June 2022: In Al-Hol Camp, Al-Hasakah governorate. The body of an unidentified female (likely an Iraqi woman) was found in section 3 of the camp while the motive and perpetrator(s) identity are still unknown.
June 2022: Two female bodies were discovered in section 3 of Al-Hol Camp, likely killed by ISIL-affiliated elements.
Weapon Carried/Used: No Information on the Weapon Used

Event Description: June 2022: A small-scale raid/arrest campaign by ISF and Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) in sections 3, 4 and 5 of Al-Hol Camp occurred as they found a tunnel inside a tent in the annexes of the camp.
June 2022: Suspected Boko Haram militants fired mortar bombs into an IDP camp, killing at least 11 people, mostly women and children.
June 2022: A INGO aid worker was kidnapped from a refugee camp by armed individuals.
June 2022: In an IDP camp, in Hasaka governorate, the body of a woman was found in a sewer pipe bearing gunshot wounds. The perpetrators have not been identified.
June 2022: In Ituri province, an armed group attacked an IDP camp situated in the village, leaving seven dead and two wounded among the displaced population. Several houses were also burned down.
June 2022: An LNGO aid worker was injured by stones thrown by refugees during a distribution activity. Additionally, a health centre was broken into and several aid warehouses were looted.

04 June 2022. Lafon County, Easter Equatoria. Two UNSMS Organization contracted trucks were robbed by unknown armed men along the road between Ibahure and Iboni. The perpetrators looted unspecified quantities of humanitarian supplies, farming tools, and personal valuables before releasing the contractors unharmed.

June 2022: In North Darfur state, Zamzam IDP Camp was threatened with attack if stolen items were not returned and the perpetrators who were hiding inside the camp, were not arrested. A military force was dispatched to protect the camp.

June 2022: In Eastern Equatoria state, armed men broke into an IDP camp and
pillaged goods.

June 2022: In Kanyaruchinya IDP camp, several displaced people were injured during a dispute over the allocation of food supplies during a UN food distribution as the village head had only registered his family for the supplies.
June 2022: In Idlib governorate, dozens of tents at an IDP camp were damaged by rockets fired by unidentified perpetrators at a nearby military position occupied by militants.
May 2022: In Kale district, Sagaing region, seven IDPs were wounded when artillery shells hit an IDP camp, amid clashes between military forces and the PDF.
Reported Perpetrator Name: Myanmar Armed Forces, People's Defence Force (Myanmar)

Event Description: May 2022: In a camp in northern Syria, a young man's body was found in sewage in the fifth section of the camp.
May 2022: In Ar Raqqa governorate, Syrian Defence Forces arrested a civilian after they criticised how bread is distributed in a camp.

20 May 2022. Kayes. Two unidentified armed elements intercepted two IO mission vehicles and robbed the passenger staff members.  The bandits stole personal belongings, ID cards and the HF radios of the vehicles. The staff members were not physically harmed and returned to Kayes safely.
May 2022: In a refugee camp in northern Syria, the body of a female IDP was found in sewage, suspected to have been killed by IS members.
May 2022: In Al-Hol camp, Al Hasakah governorate, gunmen shot and killed a young man in the fifth section of the camp.
May 2022: An IDP female was found killed by unidentified perpetrators (likely by ISIL-affiliated elements) in Al-Hol camp.
Weapon Carried/Used: No Information on the Weapon Used

Event Description: May 2022: In Luhansk oblast, an evacuation bus carrying 33 IDPs came under fire when Russian forces shelled the highway. No civilians were harmed.
Reported Perpetrator Name: Armed Forces of the Russian Federation

Event Description: May 2022: In Al-Hol Camp, Al Hasakah governorate, the body of a female IDP was found in the fifth section of the camp, killed by unknown gunmen.
May 2022: A school sheltering displaced persons was shelled by alleged Eritrean forces.
May 2022: In Central Darfur state, four armed men intercepted an 18-year-old man from an IDP camp for the purpose of robbery, and shot him dead.
May 2022: The Police Command defused a bomb planted by Boko Haram and ISWAP insurgents at Dalori Camp
11 May 2022: In Jenin Refugee Camp, Israeli forces shot dead a 51-year-old female Al Jazeera journalist during a camp raid.

May 2022: In South Darfur state, gunmen on a Land Cruiser opened fire on an IDP Camp, killing a 38-year-old man, and wounding a 35-year-old woman. The perpetrators then fled the scene, leaving residents of the camp in a state of panic.

May 2022: In an unnamed refugee camp, an Arab ethnic militia attacked and beat up civilians a
and attempted to set ablaze the police commissariat in retaliation to the assassination of a family member.

May 2022: In Chittagong division, district police arrested 453 Rohingya refugees for leaving their camps, whilst members of the Armed Police Battalion arrested 203 more refugees at areas adjacent to their camps and at different checkpoints. The refugees had reportedly left to celebrate Eid al-Fitr, but the Government of Bangladesh strictly limits their movement out of the camps at any time.

May 2022: In Borno state, members of the Civilian Joint Task Force arrested five men for vandalising a solar powered borehole which was meant to provide portable water to 70,000 IDPs, and for selling its inverters on the black market. The buyers were also arrested and handed over to security agencies for investigation.
Weapon Carried/Used: No Information on the Weapon Used

Event Description: May 2022: Russian troops halted the movement of a convoy of IDPs leaving Kherson oblast to make way for the transportation of their military equipment. When the IDP convoy reached Ukrainian-controlled territory, Russian forces fired artillery at it, wounding a 10-year-old child and a 67-year-old woman.
Reported Perpetrator Name: Armed Forces of the Russian Federation

Event Description: 27 April 2022:In Jenin Refugee Camp, Israeli forces shot dead an 18-year-old Palestinian man during a camp raid. Three other Palestinian youth were also wounded by Israeli live fire.

April 2022: Across the Darfur region, amidst mounting concerns regarding the fate of a former Janjaweed leader whose trial has recently begun at the International Criminal Court, violence perpetrated by Janjaweed militias is believed to be partially aimed at depopulating towns and dismantling unnamed IDP camps, as these represent the most visible proof of war crimes, ethnic cleansing and crimes against humanity perpetrated by the same Janjaweed during the Omar al-Bashir era.

26 April 2022: In Aqabet Jaber Refugee Camp, some residents threw stones, set fire to tires and threw Molotov cocktails towards Israeli forces who were conducting a raid. Israeli soldiers responded with riot dispersal equipment and live fire, critically wounding a 20-year-old Palestinian man who died several hours later at a hospital.

April 2022: In West Darfur state, Janjaweed militiamen attacked an IDP camp, burning dozens of houses and forcing large numbers of people to flee. 16 people were wounded, including three left in critical condition.
24 April 2022: In Qalandia Refugee Camp, Isreli forces stormed a number of Palestinian homes in the camp, where they arrested two Palestinian youths.

April 2022: Five female dead bodies were found murdered in the 4th section of AL-Hol camp. They were reportedly killed by ISIL cells due to their collaborating with Syria Democratic Forces (SDF) in the camp. Additionally, an Iraqi male was wounded by an ISIL cell, who targeted him in the 1st section of the camp.

April 2022: In Penang state, 528 mostly Rohingya refugees fled a temporary immigration detention centre amid a riot inside the compound. Six people, including two women and two children, lost their lives as they tried to cross a nearby highway and were struck by fast-moving vehicles. Of all escapees, 88 were caught by nearby villagers, while 362 were rearrested by police.
April 2022: In South Darfur state, an unidentified perpetrator stabbed to death a 30-year-old pregnant woman inside her home at an IDP Camp.
April 2022: In northwestern Syria, an Iraqi woman was found dead with two bullets to her head and one in the shoulder in a refugee camp.
April 2022: In northwestern Syria, two women of unidentified origin were found dead near a mosque in a refugee camp.
